releases.body:
v0.8.5 removes the dev/ tooling and the check workflow from the repo, so the installed plugin contains only plugin files. This clears the directory's credential-forwarding flag, which came from a test helper under dev/. The installed plugin behaves the same as v0.8.4.

Skills, commands, the operator, and the production gateway are unchanged.

Full changelog: https://github.com/arcadeai-labs/omnimcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v0.8.4 removes the bundled image references from every manifest and drops the dev scripts that passed credential environment variables (ChatGPT packaging, the Claude install check, and Codex and Copilot verification). The installed plugin is otherwise the same as v0.8.3.

Skills, commands, the operator, and the production gateway are unchanged.

Full changelog: https://github.com/arcadeai-labs/omnimcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

v0.8.3 removes the unused workflow fixture that forwarded github.token. The installed plugin is otherwise the same as v0.8.2.

Skills, commands, the operator, and the production gateway are unchanged.

Full changelog: https://github.com/arcadeai-labs/omnimcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Directory-safe 0.8.2. Claude Code and Cursor still get the session-start hook that v0.6.0 already shipped. Prompt, subagent, and Copilot hook registrations are not in this release, and telemetry does not read the process environment.

The prompt and subagent scripts stay in the repo for a follow-up. Skills, commands, the operator, and the production gateway are unchanged.

Full changelog: https://github.com/arcadeai-labs/omnimcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Arcade plugin 0.8.1, synced from ArcadeAI/arcade-plugin.

- The Copilot CLI install docs now add the marketplace first, then install `arcade@arcade`.
- The telemetry docs list allowed values with commas instead of escaped pipes.
- Version bumped to 0.8.1 in `VERSION` and the Claude, Cursor, and root plugin manifests.

Docs and version only. Skills, commands, hooks, and the MCP server work the same.

Full changelog: https://github.com/arcadeai-labs/omnimcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
